purpose: Selects the funnel catalog's funnels for a site: one funnel by id, or every funnel whose first step holds a session floor.
data: Funnel subjects, most first-step sessions first, each with its catalog steps and first-step sessions after the confirmed-bot filter.

funnel.description: a funnel id from src/catalog/funnels.json, chosen whatever its volume

minSessions.description: first-step sessions a funnel needs; 100 when absent
